citations.title: Incident Report INC-2026-0311 - Card payment processing delays
citations.section: Incident Report INC-2026-0311 - Card payment processing delays > Summary
citations.text: On 2026-03-11 card payments submitted through the Checkout API were delayed and some failed with timeout errors. The incident started at 14:05 UTC and was resolved at 16:40 UTC. Fraud-scoring latency was elevated after the fraud model v3.3 rollout earlier that day. The model was rolled back and the payment-gateway database connection pool was enlarged.

citations.title: Postmortem INC-2026-0311 - Card payment processing delays
citations.section: Postmortem INC-2026-0311 - Card payment processing delays > Summary
citations.text: Between 13:52 and 16:40 UTC on 2026-03-11, card payments were delayed or failed. Two changes combined to cause the incident. CHG-2044 rolled out fraud model v3.3, which raised fraud-scoring p99 latency from about 80 ms to about 450 ms. CHG-2041, made two days earlier, had reduced the payment-gateway database connection pool from 200 to 60 connections. Neither change caused problems on its own.
